formula_checks.name: undoSnapshot
formula_checks.why: Deep copies only affected accounts before mutation, allowing exact restoration rather than an approximate opposite trade.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: restoreUndo
formula_checks.why: Replaces affected accounts with authoritative pre-transaction copies; unrelated accounts remain unchanged.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: inverseOf
formula_checks.why: Direction flipping plus kind switching is clear for explicit in/out records, but legacy signed-negative records without direction can be reversed twice depending on whether amount or kind owns its sign.
formula_checks.should_be: Normalize to explicit signed cash once, then generate the opposite; preserve exact snapshots when available.

formula_checks.name: txnLabel
formula_checks.why: The literal transaction-kind-to-label mapping is absent.
formula_checks.should_be: Supply approved label mapping, keeping unknown-kind fallback explicit.

formula_checks.name: cashEffect
formula_checks.why: A missing amount returns 0 for a financial display even when its cash effect is unknown. Sale amount fallback also lacks a fee contract.
formula_checks.should_be: Return unknown effect for unentered amounts; keep confirmed zero distinct and define amount-only fee treatment.

formula_checks.name: investmentIncomeAnnual
formula_checks.why: The trailing window has a lower bound but no stated upper bound at as_of, allowing future-dated payouts. Missing amounts silently disappear from a purported total.
formula_checks.should_be: Use lower_bound ≤ date ≤ as_of, preserve signed reversals, and expose missing-amount coverage.

formula_checks.name: isMoneyOut
formula_checks.why: Kind-based unknown classification is explicitly only a flag, not a guessed amount; signed refunds/reversals are excluded correctly.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: normPayee
formula_checks.why: Trims outer whitespace and folds case; does not merge distinct payee identities or internal whitespace.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: daysApart
formula_checks.why: Absolute difference of date-only records is correct; timestamps require the declared calendar/elapsed convention.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: reviewTransactions
formula_checks.why: Flags possible issues appropriately, but earlier-history direction, same-timestamp duplicates, negative reversal magnitudes, median convention, and duplicate normalized payees need explicit definitions.
formula_checks.should_be: Use prior dated normalized money-outs only; state even-sample median and inclusive boundaries; preserve both possible duplicates for user choice.

formula_checks.name: flagComparisonText
formula_checks.why: Threshold says at least $1000 while its fallback prose says over $1000; exactly $1000 is described inaccurately.
formula_checks.should_be: Say $1000 or more and retain human-reviewed templates and amounts.

Import 100 VTI (cost $8,000), then sell 10 at $98.00: realized +$180 all time (it read "not on record").
